about: 계좌입출금 삭제 — 이 화면에서 직접 넣은 입금을 [삭제] 하면 잔액이 되돌아가고 분개도 지워진다(63회차). 입금은 API 로 만들고 화면에서 지운다.

shots.name: 준비 — 입금 1건(API)
steps: js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:Promise.all(['/bank-cards/accounts','/accounts'].map((p) => window.__api('GET', p))).then(([b, a]) => window.__api('POST', '/bank-cards/transactions', { bankAccountId: b.body.find((x) => x.active).id, deposit: true, amount: 4321, counterAccountId: a.body.find((x) => x.code === '101').id, txnDate: new Date(Date.now() + 9 * 36e5).toISOString().slice(0, 10), description: 'QA 화면시험 63' })).then((r) => { sessionStorage.setItem('bkNo', r.body.txnNo); return r.status })

shots.name: [삭제]
steps: js:(() => { const tr = [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].find((t) => t.innerText.includes(sessionStorage.getItem('bkNo'))); [...tr.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.innerText === '삭제').click(); return true })()
